name: DPDP Act 2023 Section 8 - Technical & Organizational Security Safeguards
standard: Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, Section 8(5)
what_it_decides: Mandates that data fiduciaries implement reasonable security safeguards including end-to-end encryption at rest and in transit to prevent personal data breaches.

name: DPDP Act 2023 Section 9 - Additional Obligations in Relation to Children
standard: Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, Section 9(1)-(3)
what_it_decides: Prohibits tracking, behavioral monitoring, or targeted advertising directed at children, and requires verifiable parental consent before processing child personal data.

name: CERT-In Directions 2022 - Mandatory 180-Day System and Audit Log Retention
what_it_decides: Mandates that all service providers, intermediaries, and corporate entities maintain system and security audit logs securely within the Indian jurisdiction for a rolling 180-day period.

name: RBI Master Direction on Information Technology Governance and Controls 2023
standard: Reserve Bank of India Master Direction - IT Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance Practices (2023)
what_it_decides: Requires financial and risk-scoring systems to maintain model explainability, verifiable audit trails, and human oversight for high-risk automated lending or underwriting decisions.
